posture: 69 roles · 17 strong-act · 3 day-rate/interim worth moving on today — full Chrome-verified sweep
summary: Monday morning refresh: every item below was opened and confirmed live in the browser this run with a working deep link. The standout is Director, Audit at the NSW Department of Education — an ongoing SES Band 1 role in Parramatta at $255k–$281k, closing 27 August. NSW Government is the busiest surface today, with Transport for NSW alone advertising four assurance/governance leadership roles; Seek added a healthcare CFO (Wexford Hayes), APRA's Head of FP&A and a part-time Assistant Company Secretary at Squadron Energy overnight. Two items were dropped as no longer live: the Insignia Senior Manager, Operational Risk Framework role and the NSW Reconstruction Authority Manager Audit & Assurance (closed 16 Aug). Browser-verified this run: Seek, I Work for NSW, EthicalJobs, Robert Half, Kaizen, Bluefin, Michael Page, Sharp & Carter, Derwent, Board Direction and Hutton Education. AICD Directorship Opportunities is now fully login-walled — no public teasers were visible, so nothing was logged from it and it remains worth a manual look if you hold a subscription. Board Direction likewise shows only card-level teasers to non-members. Hutton Education's current list is all principal/deputy-principal roles, so nothing on-target there today. Coverage is a sample, not a census — a manual pass over Seek's Board Appointments subclassification and the executive search firms that never advertise (Watermark, NGS, Blenheim, Stanton Chase) remains worthwhile.
